subject.title: [Bug]: xAI/Grok "could not decrypt encrypted_content" 400 trips the per-model circuit breaker (no auto-recovery)

question: Should maintainers accept source-level repro, redacted pre-fix production logs, and focused unit coverage as sufficient proof for the linked xAI/Grok recovery PR given that xAI's provider-side stale-blob rotation cannot be triggered on demand?
rationale: The remaining blocker is proof sufficiency for a provider-owned failure mode, not product direction or an unclear code path.

options.title: Accept source and production-log proof

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix proof
